title: The search results page reflects whatever you searched for
brief: The 'you searched for X' banner echoes the query back. Dan found that a crafted link sent to a signed-in customer runs code in their session -- no review needed, just a URL.

attackSuite.label: Closes the tag, then opens its own

functionalSuite.label: A search containing an angle bracket

hints: The bold tag is part of the design, so the whole banner cannot simply become text.
Separate the parts you wrote from the part the customer typed. Only one of them should be markup.
Build the <strong> element yourself and set its textContent to the term.
